item.title: After win at the ballot box, The Montana Plan draws legal challenge
item.description: On the same day that voters approved a ballot initiative that disallows corporate spending in Montana elections, several groups — including the Montana Republican State Central Committee — filed a lawsuit challenging the constitutionality of the measure.
